title: Core: AS2 Color class compilation
description: Verify AS2 Color class compiles correctly: new Color(target), c.setRGB(0xff0000), c.getRGB(), c.setTransform({ra, rb, ga, gb, ba, bb, aa, ab}), c.getTransform(). Tests in packages/core/src/as2/__tests__/colorclass.test.ts. Verify ActionNew (0x4a), ActionCallMethod (0x52), ActionGetMember (0x4f) opcodes are emitted.
